caption: The drawing depicts a sculpture or figurine of two cats sitting closely together on an oval base, both with their tails curled around their bodies and touching each other at the center. The cats have rounded faces, pointed ears, and large eyes, with detailed fur texture indicated by swirled and wavy lines. The coloration of the sculpture is mostly shades of brown and dark orange, with some lighter highlights suggesting a shiny or polished surface. The background is plain and uncolored, with the central object clearly defined and occupying the lower central part of the image. The overall composition places the two cats as a unified form, with their bodies merging at the sides and their heads positioned next to each other, both facing forward.
title: Door Stop
